start.mapping: Display start; model dates begin 2009-01-01 UTC. Earlier dates return na.

end.mapping: Display end; limits history and future drawings within 2050.

selected.mapping: TradingView Bar Replay supplies the selected chart time. The inspection table and its timestamp controls were deliberately removed.

bodies.mapping: All / Custom / Hide all, ten independent toggles and colors. All enables nine core bodies; Moon still opt-in.

pair.mapping: Pair first / second; every supported body. Calculation includes a selected Moon even when hidden.

coordinate_mode.mapping: Geometric geocentric mean ecliptic/equinox of date only. Apparent-of-date, astrometric-of-date and legacy J2000 are NOT implemented or offered.

scale.mapping: See every Scale field below; exact price arithmetic, different documented astronomical model.

market.mapping: Chart OHLC and metadata plus editable research calendar; see MarketSpec below.

column_mapping.mapping: CSV/Parquet column parsing has no meaning for TradingView chart OHLC.

price_file.mapping: The installed indicator consumes the active chart; it cannot read a local file.

low.mapping: Shared minimum price (default 70,000), with a per-body override; used for branch selection, clipping, future paths and contacts.

high.mapping: Shared maximum price (default 125,000), per-body overrides and independent 0–12 main counts. Keep eligible branches and replenish on exit; counts exclude opposites. Combined active requests must fit 32 curves.

orb.mapping: Aspect orb degrees, 0–5.9; refined entry/exit around all phase targets and exact modulo-24 clock matches.

occupancy_mode.mapping: continuous [0,1], rounded_labels [-0.5,1.5], degree_buckets [0,2] repeated modulo 24; boundary events retained.

clock_alignment_mode.mapping: exact_phase modulo 24, or rounded_sector boundaries searched in each body. Neither is zodiac conjunction.

step_hours.mapping: Event grid hours (1–6); historical resolution follows chart bars. Maximum future sample hours (1–24), additionally capped by body speed. No historical-day limit.

future_days.mapping: Future days 0–700 (default 7). Future-only budgets: 96 paths, 6000 body samples and 40000 vertices. Historical plots cover all loaded bars with no rolling day/calc-bar cap.

session_policy.mapping: strict / previous / next assignment of non-session closing dates; never substitutes partial session ranges.

window_days.mapping: Expanded window ± calendar days, capped at 3. Strict, assigned and expanded results remain separate.

shifts.mapping: Cycle shifts CSV, at most five. Every shift creates a retained hit/miss/unavailable/pending candidate; no best-shift selection.

last_family_dates.mapping: Previous events per target, 1–5; retained event history bounded at 128 and analysis window at 180 days.

comparison_mode.mapping: family or consecutive; manual sequences remain local-only because Pine has no persistent arbitrary event-selection editor.

conjunction_pairs.mapping: Comparison mode Mercury superior to inferior; distances identify type. Each superior is consumed by its following inferior.

opposite.mapping: Opposites add 12 steps. Each side retains its eligible branches and replenishes on exit, up to N each within the bracket. Combined historical capacity is 32 curves including opposites.

halfway.mapping: Halfway lines: offsets 3.5, 9.5, 15.5, 21.5; independent of A–D bands.

adjoining.mapping: Adjoining support/resistance [d-2.5,d] / [d+1,d+3.5], independent of bands; unanchored static geometry.

monthly_sample.mapping: Monthly reproduction: UTC first-of-month endpoint rounding followed by linear interpolation, using local shortest-angle endpoint semantics, including Moon aliasing.

tolerance_seconds.mapping: Root tolerance seconds, 1–300, numerical bracket width only; model error is separately measured.

contacts.mapping: Calculate price contacts, labels, alerts and tag filters; see all ContactSettings fields below.

sequences.mapping: The local arbitrary 2–4 event sequence editor and persistence are not implemented; use supported family/consecutive or Mercury pairing in Pine.

annotations.mapping: Three bounded manual timestamp/text annotations, each with an enable toggle. Saved workspace annotation lists remain local.

scale_locked.mapping: Bitcoin 369 preset fixes effective unit at 369; Manual activates Manual units per step.

preset.mapping: Bitcoin 369 or Manual; other named historical presets can be reproduced numerically with Manual but are not extra preset menus.

schema_version.mapping: Local workspace JSON version; Pine inputs are saved by TradingView and do not deserialize workspace JSON.

unit.mapping: Bitcoin 369 / Manual units per step; positive values only.

rounding.mapping: Book = floor(L+0.5), Continuous = L; negative half ties match Python.

quote_units.mapping: syminfo.currency and syminfo.ticker; USD and USDT remain distinct, with no currency conversion.

anchor_price.mapping: Anchor price P0, applied only when Anchor trajectories is enabled.

anchor_longitude.mapping: Anchor unwrapped longitude L0 is subtracted without rounding.

anchored.mapping: Anchor trajectories affects planetary curves only; static grid stays unanchored.

timezone.mapping: Research timezone (IANA), UTC default; separate event display timezone.

timestamp_kind.mapping: Actual Unix bar timestamps; local daily-label parsing is not a Pine feed operation.

bar_convention.mapping: Astronomy sample Bar open / Confirmed close; price availability always at confirmed close.

session_open.mapping: Research session HHMM-HHMM; default 0000-0000, closing-date labels.

session_close.mapping: Research session close with overnight/equal-open-close convention and timezone-aware DST bounds.

calendar.mapping: 24/7 or weekdays calendar, keyed by session closing date.

holidays.mapping: Up to 30 excluded ISO closing dates in Holiday closing dates CSV.

tick_size.mapping: syminfo.mintick by default; Tick override >0 changes contact tolerance and display, never the chart feed.

quote_units.mapping: syminfo.currency and syminfo.ticker; USD and USDT remain distinct, with no currency conversion.

adjustments.mapping: TradingView feed provenance; Pine cannot change corporate-action adjustments with a text input.

contract_roll.mapping: Selected chart symbol/feed determines futures roll; no fictional roll override.

symbol.mapping: Active TradingView syminfo.ticker; no exchange or CSV symbol hardcoded.

synthetic.mapping: chart.is_standard gates all price methods; synthetic OHLC is not treated as observed standard market data.

bar_minutes.mapping: Actual time/time_close coverage and timeframe.in_seconds(); standard weekly charts explicitly disable daily comparisons.

tolerance_ticks.mapping: Tolerance ticks times effective tick size; applies to touches, sides, gaps, taking confirming extremes.

separation_bars.mapping: Test separation bars; separated new touches increment first/second/retest state per branch identity (reset when a plot slot changes k).

congestion_bars.mapping: Congestion bars; consecutive touches trigger once at the configured count.

confirmation_bars.mapping: Close confirmation bars; consecutive closes beyond tolerance trigger close-through, reversal and pending extreme tests.

field.mapping: Contact field range / close; close-only touch tests still use standard OHLC for gap and extreme-taking logic, matching Python.
